common.network_error: Could not reach {name}. Check your connection and try again.
common.try_again: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

offline.heading: You are offline
offline.body: {name} needs a connection to your server to print and scan. Check your connection, then try again.

auth.session_ended: You were signed out, so this list no longer updates.
auth.signed_out_notice: You were signed out. Reload the page to sign in again.
auth.cross_site_refused: This request did not come from {name}'s own pages, so it was refused. Open {name} at {origin} and try again.

errors.heading: Sign-in failed
errors.unavailable: Sign-in provider unavailable. Try again in a moment.
errors.state: This sign-in expired or was started in another window.
errors.rejected: The sign-in provider did not sign you in.

no_access.heading: No access to {name}
no_access.body: You are signed in, but your account does not have the role needed to use {name}. Ask whoever runs it for access, or sign out and use another account.

password.invalid: The username or password is wrong.
password.too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a few seconds, then try again.
password.unavailable: Signing in failed. Try again in a moment.

account.title: Account
account.changed: Your password was changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

password.title: Change password
password.others_signed_out: Changing it signs you out everywhere else.

errors.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
errors.too_short: The new password must be at least {minimum} characters long.
errors.too_long: The new password must be at most {maximum} characters long.
errors.too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a few seconds, then try again.
errors.unavailable: The password could not be changed. Try again in a moment.

users.load_failed: The users could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

new_user.title: New local user
new_user.username_hint: Lower-case letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens.
new_user.display_name_hint: Shown in the header. The username when left empty.
new_user.password_hint: At least {minimum} characters. Share it with them safely.

done.disabled: {username} is disabled and was signed out.
done.password_set: The password of {username} was set, and {username} was signed out everywhere.

errors.username_invalid: The username must be 1 to 64 characters among lower-case letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, starting with a letter or a digit.
errors.email_taken: That email address belongs to another user.
errors.too_short: The password must be at least {minimum} characters long.
errors.too_long: The password must be at most {maximum} characters long.
errors.own_account: You cannot change this on your own account.
errors.from_claim: Administration of this user comes from the identity provider. Change it there, or on the server with recto administrator --remove.
errors.unavailable: The change could not be saved. Try again in a moment.

groups.intro: Groups and their members come from the identity provider at each sign-in, so they are read-only here.
groups.load_failed: The groups could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
groups.empty_body: Groups appear once people sign in with single sign-on and the provider sends a groups claim.

printers.intro: Choose who may print on each printer. A printer without a rule is open to everyone.
printers.empty_body: CUPS lists no printer, and no printer has a rule.
printers.listing_failed: CUPS did not answer, so only the printers with a rule are listed. Their rules can still be changed.

add.title: Add a printer
add.intro: Give the address of the printer. recto asks CUPS to add it.
add.search_hint: Only for a printer that is not IPP Everywhere. Words of the make and model, such as laserjet 1020. Searching reloads the page, so search before you fill in the rest.
add.search_failed: CUPS did not answer the driver search. The printer can still be added with IPP Everywhere.
add.name: Name
add.name_hint: Letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, up to 127 characters.
add.address_hint: Starts with ipp://, ipps://, http://, https://, socket://, lpd://, dnssd:// or usb://.
add.driver_hint: IPP Everywhere asks the printer for its capabilities, and the printer must answer.

manage.title: Manage this printer
manage.confirm: Remove {printer} from CUPS. Its waiting jobs are canceled and its access rule is forgotten.

done.described: The description and location were saved.
done.paused: The printer is paused: it holds its jobs.
done.rejecting: The printer turns new jobs away.

errors.invalid_name: The name must be 1 to 127 characters among letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens.
errors.invalid_address: The address must start with ipp://, ipps://, http://, https://, socket://, lpd://, dnssd:// or usb:// and name a host, without a user name or password.
errors.needs_confirmation: Tick the confirmation to remove the printer.
errors.refused: CUPS refused the change: check that the cups service lets recto administer it.
errors.unreachable: The printer could not be reached: {message}
errors.cups_unavailable: CUPS did not answer. Try again in a moment.

scanners.intro: Choose who may scan on each scanner. A scanner without a rule is open to everyone.
scanners.empty_body: SANE lists no scanner, and no scanner has a rule.
scanners.listing_failed: SANE did not answer, so only the scanners with a rule are listed. Their rules can still be changed.

devices.load_failed: The rules could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
devices.no_groups: No groups yet. Without a group, only administrators can use it.
devices.administrators_note: Administrators can always use every device. With no group ticked, only they can.
devices.forget_hint: Drops the rule of a device that is gone. If it comes back, it is open to everyone.

errors.no_access: The form did not say who may use the device.
errors.unknown_group: A chosen group no longer exists. Nothing was saved.
errors.unavailable: The change could not be saved. Try again in a moment.

print.title: Print
print.file_hint: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to {size}.

errors.too_large: The file is too large to print.
errors.unsupported_format: Only PDF, JPEG and PNG files can be printed. Save or export the document as PDF first.
errors.printer_not_found: That printer no longer exists. Choose another one.
errors.not_accepting: That printer is not accepting jobs right now.
errors.invalid_copies: That number of copies is not one this printer accepts.
errors.unsupported_sides: This printer does not support that two-sided setting.
errors.unsupported_color: This printer does not support that color mode.
errors.invalid_page_ranges: The page range is not valid. Write it like 1-3, 5.
errors.invalid_form: The print form was incomplete. Try again.
errors.unavailable: The printing service is unavailable. Try again later.
errors.refused: The printing service refused the request.

printers.title: Printers
printers.empty_body: Add a printer to CUPS, then reload this page.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.submitted: Sent to the printer as job {id}.
jobs.empty_body: Documents you print show up here.

scan.title: Scan
scan.needs_javascript: Scanning needs JavaScript. Turn it on in your browser to preview and scan.
scan.no_scanners: No scanners found. Check that the scanner is on, then look again.
scan.first_page_only: PNG and JPEG keep only the first page from the feeder.
scan.preview_needs_flatbed: Preview works from the flatbed only: from the feeder it would pull the first sheet through. Feeder pages are scanned whole.

activity.scanning: Scanning… If the scanner is in use, your scan waits its turn.

scan.select_hint: Drag on the preview to scan only part of it.
scan.selected: Only the selected part will be scanned.
scan.no_area: This scanner always scans its whole area.

errors.busy: The scanner is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.not_found: Scanner not found. It may be off or unplugged; refresh the list.
errors.unsupported: The scanner does not support this: {what}
errors.too_large: This scan would be too large for {name}. Lower the resolution or select a smaller area.
errors.interrupted: The scan stopped unexpectedly. Try again.
errors.connection_lost: The connection to {name} was cut before the scan finished. The scan may still be finishing, but its result is lost: scan again in a moment. If {name} is behind a reverse proxy, raise the proxy's read timeout.
errors.encoding: The scan could not be encoded: {reason}
errors.result_not_found: This scan does not exist or has expired.
errors.save_disabled: Saving to a folder is not set up.
